description: Upkeep phase with an 'at the beginning of your upkeep' triggered ability source on the battlefield; empty stack. Core + delayed-trigger + battlefield buckets (no stack bucket). System 3 should surface triggered-ability/upkeep rules. REQ-179: System 3 excludes only the exact rule numbers a selected curated topic lists, so rule 603.3b, a lettered sub-rule of curated topic abilities-trigger-basics' rule 603.3 that the topic does not list, competes for a supplemental slot like any other rule; the expected supplemental set below names only the rule this case must surface (500.6) and does not pin 603.3b either way.

request.question: It's my upkeep. My Phyrexian Arena's beginning-of-upkeep trigger and my opponent's beginning-of-upkeep trigger both want to go on the stack — who chooses the order and when do they trigger?

battlefield.name: Phyrexian Arena
battlefield.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
